name: automation
description: Run, save and re-run ordered workflows of desktop actions. Steps are executed in order through the same permission, approval and lock path as a single action, and every run is written to a real history file. A step that fails stops the workflow and is reported — a partial run is never presented as complete.

action.description: run | save | list | run_saved | history | delete

steps.description: JSON array of steps for run/save.

condition.description: Optional gate: a feature flag name that must be enabled.

settings.label: Maximum steps per workflow
settings.help: The sequence engine allows at most 15 steps.

settings.label: History entries to keep
settings.help: Older runs are dropped once the limit is reached.

settings.label: Default condition
settings.help: A feature flag that must be enabled before a workflow runs (blank = always).
